title: 认证工件与租约：中断后同身份重放
expectedCaseTitles: ProjectContext certified facts foundation reopens durable content-addressed artifacts and refuses a second run consumer
ProjectContext certified facts foundation replays an immutable publish interrupted after the atomic publish step
ProjectContext certified facts foundation ignores an orphan temp after file fsync and refuses a partial immutable final
ProjectContext certified facts foundation replays lease acquisition and completion crashes without exposing partial JSON
fixtureDescription: 每case在os.tmpdir()/project-facts-*建真实文件存储。artifact由createCaptureInput/createHostPorts受控数据经实际capture生成；host port是测试夹具，不是现场源码项目。故障通过store durability.onStep在immutable-after-publish、immutable-after-temp-fsync、lease-after-publish、replace-after-rename抛Error；恢复用新FileCertifiedProjectFactsStore实例显式put/acquire/complete。
observations: put后open与原artifact深相等；同run lease取得acquired再resumed，新实例consumerPort也resumed；不同run或bindingHash拒绝ProjectFactsLeaseConflictError。
immutable publish后注入错误；新store put同artifact成功且open深相等。
temp-fsync后错误留下.tmp文件；重放put成功；伪造partial final导致collision且原partial字节未被覆盖。
lease-after-publish中断后同run显式acquire返回resumed，不同run被拒；replace-after-rename中断后同身份complete返回completed。
limitations: 通过步骤hook模拟中断，不是杀进程、断电或磁盘硬件故障实验。
实测同进程新store实例，不是独立操作系统进程恢复；不得用fresh process描述V03。

不自动接管其他run，不自动重新执行consumer adapter。
本回执按完整Core产品库存绑定来源；主要实现路径用于阅读导航，不代表完整传递调用闭包。
